name: Ox Alpha
description: Ox Alpha was an anonymous stealth-preview reasoning model for coding, sustained agentic work, and production workloads. OpenRouter reported that the model was revealed as Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash and is no longer available under the Ox Alpha name.

details.name: revealed_identity
details.value: OpenRouter reported that Ox Alpha was revealed as Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash; this record preserves the retired Ox Alpha identity rather than aliasing it to the replacement.

sources.notes: OpenRouter lists the model as released on 2026-08-20, records that it was revealed as Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash, and directs users to that replacement model. The Ox Alpha route is therefore retained as historical catalogue data and explicitly retired today.

verification.notes: Retirement is based on the current OpenRouter model page stating that Ox Alpha was revealed as Z.AI GLM-5.3-Flash and is no longer the active model identity.
